data.name: Cooper Electric Service
data.address: 5647 Cancun Dr, North Richland Hills, TX 76180

reviews.text:
Cooper’s Electric did an exceptional job at our location! From start to finish, the service was professional, knowledgeable, and incredibly efficient. Blake and Cameron were an amazing team-  respectful, skilled, and clearly experts at what they do. They installed additional plugs for us, and the work was done perfectly. Everything was completed neatly and with great attention to detail. We truly couldn’t be happier with the results.
Highly recommend Cooper’s Electric for anyone who wants qualit

Jerry and Cameron came out on time today and installed a light switch to an outside light. I wanted to be able to turn the day/night off so my solar lights would come on. They also installed a new plug in for my smoker as it went out. They were only here maybe a little over an hour and they got it all done. We will be using them for our electric jobs in the future. They were very reasonable and both just as nice as can be.

Great experience. We were having issues with our breaker box and AC unit, they came out quickly to evaluate the situation. Electrical issues can be scary, but I would highly recommend Cooper Electric. They are professional, honest and responsive. David is very knowledgeable and takes the time to explain things. We will be using them for all future electrical needs.

My property management company reached out to Cooper Electric Services for a hardwire stove removal and putting in an outlet for the new stove. I promptly got a call from a sweet woman named Brenda, she got some electricians out to me within a very reasonable time frame. Andrew & Dawson were early and got the job done quickly. They even went above and beyond and took the old stove to the curb for me. I would definitely recommend them.

🌟🌟🌟🌟🌟

We’ve used Cooper Electric several times and  we highly recommend them!  Their electricians are knowledgeable and do excellent work with a helpful and happy disposition.  They go above and beyond to ensure you are completely satisfied with their service. We won’t use anyone else!
Thanks for your great service Cooper Electric!

We installed two ceiling fans ourselves.  The light on the ceiling fan that we installed wouldn't work.  Kristin and Andrew came out.  They were a great team!  Kristin took the switch cover off and discovered that our new fan/light required a LED light switch.  They went out and got one, installed it and finished up all within an hour.  They were very pleasant as well!  I highly recommend Cooper Electric Service!
Landon and Jared/Cooper Electric Services are the best in the field.  If needing any type of electric work done call them.  They are honest, dependable, affordable and extremely knowledgeable.

Found out one of my outlets was smoked; had a lot of wires to it and I wanted a professional to evaluate and repair so that the house doesn't go up in smoke! Kristin handled the job very easily and put my mind at ease regarding my house wiring. Very sharp, knows her business. Cooper will be my go-to going forward.  Thanks Kristin!

David came out to provide an estimate and was very polite and professional. The tech showed up early and was very friendly and knowledgeable. He explained the work as he went along and displayed a high quality craftsmanship. I am very pleased with the work they did and I also received what I felt was a very good price. I have some future plans for some lighting projects in my kitchen and I will definitely use Cooper Electric again. *UPDATE* I had to call Cooper back to make a correction on an ov
They installed a ceiling fan and updated our kitchen and garage lights from fluorescent to LED. Honest work with fair prices. Plan to use them in the future to update light sockets

5 Star operation over there.  Left a message to make an appointment, got a call back within 30 minutes.  Appointment was for the next day.  They had a cancellalation and was able to come the same day.  The technician who arrived (Andrew) was awesome. He was knowledgable, courteous, and conscious of time with regard to pricing. He let me know at every step that I could probably finish the next couple of steps my self and save some money. I am glad I took the time to do the research and found this

Perfect experience from a wonderful company. Call was answered quickly and they were able to send someone out within a couple of days. Brenda arrived on time, was nice, courteous and professional. She not only resolved the problem, but improved on the previous lighting in our Living Room. It now looks fantastic.

I highly recommend this company and feel grateful that I have found a company like this I can rely on in the future. Thank you so much Brenda!

Cooper Electric will be the only electrical company I call from now on.  This company has the highest integrity of any I have ever dealt with.  From fixing the issue with my electric to taking the time and listening to my concerns and finally to a follow up call this morning to make sure we were completely satisfied.  WE ABSOLUTELY WERE!  David thank you so much for restoring my faith in the industry.

This was my first time to use Cooper Electric and I was very pleased with their work. Besides the work they did I think David's daughter made a new friend with my dog Beau. I would definitely recommend this company and if & when I need electrical work in the future Cooper Electric will be who I call.

I am a General Contractor and I have been using David and his team for 7 years.   I do not call anyone else.   They are johnny on the spot always and never have to do anything twice.  It gets done right the first time every time.  Prices are always fair.  Corners are never cut.  David is very knowledgeable in his field.   I do not have to have a second contractor to keep him honest.  David is a man of integrity on the job and off the job.   I cannot say enough about David and his team.   Behind

I called Cooper Electric on a Thursday and they had someone out here the very next morning. They sent three electricians for my job because I have very high ceilings and they had to maneuver a very large ladder. All the electricians were professional and personable. They even noticed a couple other light bulbs that could be changed and did that while they were here. The price was very reasonable especially considering there were three
electricians. It was a great experience from the first phone

David Cooper and team are absolutely incredible! We have used them over the years for installing lights, ceiling fans, etc. Most recently, they drove to our house in North Dallas to do a punch list of various items which took an entire day. Their focus to detail and customer service is why they are our go to electrical contractor. They are prompt, knowledgeable, and go above and beyond.

Called these guys on a Thursday afternoon and had someone out same day, fortunately the weather and schedule worked out in our favor. Great customer service, someone actually answered the phone and even called to update us prior to techs arrival. We were selling our house and needed the GFCI operation in kitchen checked and a couple replaced. Tech was knowledgeable, friendly and went through whole house to test operations. Within an hour we had work completed. Love supporting a local business be

Cooper Electric did indoor and outdoor electric work for us. We are extremely happy with the work completed. Great customer service, quick and professional work, we will definitely call them again for our next project.

Cooper Electric Service provided superior customer service from the initial call scheduling an appointment with Brenda (She's wonderful!) to the Technicians arriving, repairing and resolving our electrical issues with ease. True professionals! Thank you so very much.

Brian and Sam came out and handled a few minor jobs for me. I called and they were out same day. What could have been some major work ended up being fairly straightforward, but what was most impressive was that they took the time to explain the why behind the what. I am exceedingly pleased with their work and with their general ability to communicate effectively. I highly recommend calling these folks for any electrician needs.

Awesome company! They rewired my whole house after a fire about 10 months ago.I was having some issues with my under the cabinet lighting. I called and they came the very next day to take care of it! They're polite and very professional.They will definitely be my go to electricians.

This company is used by the property management for the house I rent. They were called out to troubleshoot and repair a circuit malfunction which took the power in a part of our house offline. Even though it's peak season for electricians in Texas, they came out same-day; and had the problem resolved within 30 minutes of their arrival. Impeccable professionality and good humor with these folks - highly recommended, and I wouldn't be able to pick a better local company to work on your electrical

I feel terrible because I just realized I never got around to leaving a review from LAST YEAR. I could've sworn I did it! Last year, we gutted and remodled our 1,000 square foot house. We knew nothing about electrical and our budget was non-existent. We tore down a wall to create an open kitchen and I wanted to put electrical in my new peninsula and hide the existing electrical in the walls. I called Cooper Electric and said, "this is how much money we have. Can you do it?" and they said... "...

I called Cooper Electric to install outdoor electrical outlets and a ceiling fan in my newly constructed patio. They were very Prompt, Professional and reasonably priced for all they did.
I would highly recommend them for great service.
Kristin was completely on top of it. She was able to come the same day and also get all of the work done really fast with her helper. They are my go to!

Cooper Electric is my go to electrician!  They explained why my outlets were turning brown, showed me the damages, and changed out light fixtures to LED and WOW! what a difference.  The electricians were friendly and very clean, what more could you ask for?

Customer service at it's best. Our main breaker failed. late at night. The next morning I got s call at 8:00. Technician was re-routed to our emergency, I texted a picture of the bad breaker. The technician brought one and we were back up by 10:00. I had never used this company before but will from now on.
Thanks a ton!

UPDATE: Rude, unappreciative, inattentive people, including receptionist and David. Ignore your concerns, ignore your needs, drag out the time by ignoring you. Certainly, look elsewhere. I saw the response Brenda posted, after I wrote my review. Quite disingenuous. After receiving her response, of "what can we do to make this right." I thought that was nice, only to find that was a CYA of the review. I contacted Brenda several times saying I understand, lets have you come out and do the work. NO

We called Brenda and she got everything taken care of!
The fellows were quick and clean. We will absolutely use them again. Thanks Cooper Electrical!!
Quick and professional work efficiently completed.  Very reasonable cost for all the work done.  Will call them again when my next project appears. Five stars!

So they've never actually been to my house to repair anything yet but when I called to ask them to come out and fix an issue I was having the lady that answered walked me through fixing my issue when she could've easily just scheduled the repair and charged me a bunch of money... for that reason alone they will be the only company I call for electrical issues
I cut a tree and broke a line coming from the meter. I called Cooper and they came out right away. They fixed it so fast. Thank you Cooper for a great job!
Had a major electrical problem in our house that we just bought. I had someone out within an hour and it was fixed within a few days. Highly recommend.
These people are fantastic! Did a lot of work for us and did a phenomenal job. Highly recommend. Reasonable rates as well.
Definitely NOT the company to use. They are extremely unprofessional and rude. Unless you want a half done job at best, I suggest you find another company to use. Very unsatisfied with this "company"
Fast work and great service. They figured out my issue quickly and the price was very reasonable.
Awesome service. Reasonably priced w/ high quality work…
Was real good very nice with details and service
Always impressed with the speed and accuracy of their work.
Very proficient and professional.
